color.note: Cool slate neutrals stacked as glass over a canvas, one teal accent (Tide), and four status hues that each carry a glyph too.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The app backdrop behind every glass layer; shows in the gutters between rail, sidebar, main and side panel.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Translucent chrome: project rail, sidebar, side-panel header, floating menus. Always with backdrop blur `blur-glass` over `canvas`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The working surface: the chat column and panel bodies.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, the composer, popovers, menus, the selected sidebar row.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: terminal, code blocks, inputs inside raised cards, hovered rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and inside panels. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, checkboxes): 3:1 on canvas, glass and every surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on canvas, glass and every surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, timestamps, placeholders, inactive tabs. On canvas, glass and every surface.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on an `ink` fill (tooltips).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Tide, the one brand hue. Primary action, selection, focus, links and the running state; as text on any surface or `accent-soft`.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind `accent` text: selected row marker, active tab, mention chip.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill (the primary button).

tokens.name: running
tokens.usage: Status: an agent is working. Alias of `accent`; always drawn with the spinning ring glyph.

tokens.name: running-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind `running` text in a badge.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: Status: needs you (a question, a permission, a decision). The loudest state; text on any surface or `attention-soft`.

tokens.name: attention-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind `attention` text; the tint of a row that needs you.

tokens.name: review
tokens.usage: Status: finished with changes to review. Text on any surface or `review-soft`.

tokens.name: review-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind `review` text.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: Status: finished, nothing to review. Deliberately quiet: an alias of `ink-muted`, carried by the check glyph.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Status failed, destructive actions, errors; text on any surface or `danger-soft`.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind `danger` text; destructive confirm surfaces.

tokens.name: diff-add
tokens.usage: Added lines and +N counts, on surfaces or `diff-add-soft`. Always paired with a + sign: never told from `diff-del` by hue alone.

tokens.name: diff-add-soft
tokens.usage: Added-line background in the changes view.

tokens.name: diff-del
tokens.usage: Removed lines and −N counts, on surfaces or `diff-del-soft`. Always paired with a − sign.

tokens.name: diff-del-soft
tokens.usage: Removed-line background in the changes view.

tokens.name: diff-add-strong
tokens.usage: The changed words inside an added line (word-level highlight) in the changes view; `ink` and every `code-*` stay readable on it.

tokens.name: diff-del-strong
tokens.usage: The changed words inside a removed line.

tokens.name: code-keyword
tokens.usage: Syntax: keywords (const, return, async, if).

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: Syntax: strings and template literals.

tokens.name: code-number
tokens.usage: Syntax: numbers and literals (true, null).

tokens.name: code-function
tokens.usage: Syntax: function and method names where they are called or declared.

tokens.name: code-comment
tokens.usage: Syntax: comments. An alias of `ink-muted`, set in italic; inside a word highlight they switch to `ink`.

tokens.name: project-ocean
tokens.usage: Project identity hue “ocean”: the monogram tile fill in the project rail and switcher. Letter on it: `on-project`.

tokens.name: project-pine
tokens.usage: Project identity hue “pine”: the monogram tile fill in the project rail and switcher. Letter on it: `on-project`.

tokens.name: project-plum
tokens.usage: Project identity hue “plum”: the monogram tile fill in the project rail and switcher. Letter on it: `on-project`.

tokens.name: project-rust
tokens.usage: Project identity hue “rust”: the monogram tile fill in the project rail and switcher. Letter on it: `on-project`.

tokens.name: project-steel
tokens.usage: Project identity hue “steel”: the monogram tile fill in the project rail and switcher. Letter on it: `on-project`.

tokens.name: project-rose
tokens.usage: Project identity hue “rose”: the monogram tile fill in the project rail and switcher. Letter on it: `on-project`.

tokens.name: on-project
tokens.usage: Monogram letter on any `project-*` fill.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Instrument Sans from Google Fonts (400–700). Dense, calm UI type with one display step.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Empty-state prompt and the project title in the switcher. Once per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The task title above the chat; dialog titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I traced the timeout to the retry wrapper in payments/client.ts.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, sidebar rows, menu items.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata under rows, timestamps, helper text.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Sidebar section labels only; set uppercase.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: Geist Mono from Google Fonts. Code, terminal and identifiers.

styles.name: mono-meta
styles.usage: Ticket keys, PR numbers, branch names, diff counts, keyboard hints.

spacing.note: 4px base. Regions are separated by space-2 gutters of canvas, not by lines.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; glyph padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls; the gutter between glass regions.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row horizontal padding; between related items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between chat turns; between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty states and page-level spacing.

radius.note: Soft rectangles that nest: an inner radius is the outer radius minus the padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Kbd hints, inline code, mention chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tabs, sidebar rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, popovers, project tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Glass regions (sidebar, main, side panel) and the composer.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status badges, avatars, the running ring.

shadow.note: Glass is lit from above: a 1px inner highlight plus a soft drop. Dark leans on the highlight.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Glass regions: rail, sidebar, main, side panel.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Composer, cards, the selected row.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, the agent picker, command palette, side-chat popover.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px surface gap, then 2px of solid accent (3:1 or more on every surface).

size.note: Fixed dimensions of the app shell.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Project rail.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Task and session sidebar (resizable 232–360px).

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: Default side panel (terminal, code, changes, actions, browser); resizable.

tokens.name: chat-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the chat column and composer.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Sidebar session rows and menu items.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs (small: 24px).

duration.note: Motion timing. Enter at the listed time, exit at about two thirds of it; nothing a person waits on runs longer than dur-slow.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Hover, press, color changes: feedback that must feel immediate.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Small state changes: toggles, tab and segmented thumbs, chips, icon morphs, tooltips.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers in, rows inserting or expanding, messages appearing, toasts.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Large moves: side panel open and close, dialogs, view changes between sessions and projects.

tokens.name: dur-glide
tokens.usage: Spring moves (with ease-glide or ease-spring): thumbs, the rail indicator, tabs reflowing, marks popping. Feels done by ~60% of it; never blocks input.

tokens.name: dur-deliberate
tokens.usage: One-off confirmations that never block: a check drawing itself, a ring pulse on a new approval.

ease.note: Curves. Enter on ease-out, leave on ease-in, glide between places on ease-glide, pop small marks on ease-spring. Springs are linear() curves sampled from a damped spring.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Anything entering: menus, messages, rows, toasts. Fast start, soft landing.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Anything leaving: menus closing, toasts dismissing, cards collapsing.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Things moving from one place to another: thumbs, the rail indicator, panels resizing, rows reordering.

tokens.name: ease-glide
tokens.usage: A real spring with about 4% overshoot (damping 0.72): thumbs, the rail indicator, tabs reflowing, menus scaling in. Lively, never wobbly.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: A bouncier spring, about 12% overshoot (damping 0.55), for small marks only: counts, pips, checks, glyph changes, the selected-preset check. Never on surfaces.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter on every `glass` region.

tokens.name: blur-pop
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter on menus and popovers.
